The thick straight line between A and B indicates the direction of the bicycle body; the rear wheel plane is in the same direction as the bicycle body, and the nearby velocity arrow v2 is vertically upward; the front wheel is deflected relative to the bicycle body, and the angle θ is marked in the figure. The front wheel velocity arrow v1 is obliquely upward along the front wheel plane; two dashed lines indicate the respective circular trajectories of the front and rear wheel axles, and the instantaneous center O is not drawn. The problem gives AB=L, OB=√3L, θ=30°, v2=3 m/s. Then reason: The bicycle can be regarded as doing circular motion around the instantaneous center O, and the velocity direction of each point is perpendicular to the radius from that point to O. The velocity v2 of point B is along the rear wheel plane, that is, along the direction of the bicycle body, so OB should be perpendicular to AB. Thus triangle OBA is a right triangle, in which AB=L and OB=√3L, so OA=√(AB^2+OB^2)=√(L^2+3L^2)=2L. When the same rigid body rotates around the same instantaneous center, the angular velocity is the same, therefore v1/v2=OA/OB. Substituting gives v1=3×(2L)/(√3L)=2√3 m/s.

raw_record.question_text: When a bicycle turns, it can be approximately regarded as the bicycle doing circular motion around a certain fixed point O (not drawn in the figure). As shown in the figure is a top view of the bicycle when turning. The front and rear wheel axles A and B of the bicycle are separated by L. The dashed lines indicate the turning trajectories of the two wheels. The distance OB is $\sqrt{3 L}$. The angle between the plane of the front wheel and the bicycle body is $\theta=30^\circ$. At this time, the speed magnitude of wheel axle B is $v_2=3\ \mathrm{m/s}$. Find the speed magnitude $v_1$ of wheel axle A.

method.method_draft: 先读图：俯视图中A为前轮轴、B为后轮轴，AB为车身方向；后轮平面与车身同向，速度v2沿后轮平面向上；前轮平面相对车身偏转θ，速度v1沿前轮平面；两条虚线是A、B各自绕同一瞬时圆心O的圆周轨迹。再用文字给出的AB=L、OB=√3 L、θ=30°、v2=3 m/s。推理时利用纯滚动/圆周运动的瞬时中心规则：任一点速度方向与该点到圆心的半径垂直，因此O在过B且垂直于后轮速度的直线上，也在过A且垂直于前轮速度的直线上；同一刚体绕同一O转动时角速度相同，所以v1/v2=OA/OB。由图形几何，AB垂直于OB，且OB=√3L，所以OA=√(L^2+(√3L)^2)=2L。于是v1=3×(2L)/(√3L)=2√3 m/s。
method.CoT_raw:

再推理：自行车可看成绕瞬时圆心O做圆周运动，各点速度方向都与该点到O的半径垂直。B点速度v2沿后轮平面即沿车身方向，所以OB应与AB垂直。于是三角形OBA为直角三角形，其中AB=L，OB=√3L，所以OA=√(AB^2+OB^2)=√(L^2+3L^2)=2L。同一刚体绕同一瞬时圆心转动时角速度相同，因此v1/v2=OA/OB。代入得v1=3×(2L)/(√3L)=2√3 m/s。
